# @aeye — Multi-Provider AI Library for TypeScript

> A modern, type-safe AI library for Node.js and TypeScript. Unified interface for OpenAI, OpenRouter, Replicate, AWS Bedrock, and custom providers with automatic model selection, cost tracking, streaming, and composable AI components.

## Packages

- @aeye/core: Core primitives — Tool, Prompt, Agent classes and shared types
- @aeye/ai: Main library — AI class, model registry, APIs, lifecycle hooks, cost tracking
- @aeye/openai: OpenAI provider — chat, vision, images, speech, transcription, embeddings, reasoning
- @aeye/openrouter: OpenRouter provider — multi-provider gateway, routing, ZDR, model source
- @aeye/replicate: Replicate provider — open-source models with adapter/transformer system
- @aeye/aws: AWS Bedrock provider — Converse API for Claude, Llama, Mistral, Titan, Stability AI
- @aeye/models: Auto-generated model registry with pricing, capabilities, and Replicate transformers

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { AI } from '@aeye/ai';
import { OpenAIProvider } from '@aeye/openai';
import z from 'zod';

const ai = AI.with<MyContext>()
  .providers({ openai: new OpenAIProvider({ apiKey: '...' }) })
  .create();

const myTool = ai.tool({ name: 'getWeather', description: '...', schema: z.object({ city: z.string() }), call: async ({ city }) => ({ temp: 72 }) });
const myPrompt = ai.prompt({ name: 'advisor', content: 'Check weather in {{city}}.', input: (i: { city: string }) => i, tools: [myTool], schema: z.object({ suggestion: z.string() }) });
const myAgent = ai.agent({ name: 'reviewer', refs: [myTool, myPrompt] as const, call: async (input, [tool, prompt], ctx) => { /* orchestrate */ } });
```

## API Surface

```
ai.chat.get(request, ctx?) → Response
ai.chat.stream(request, ctx?) → AsyncGenerator<Chunk>
ai.image.generate.get(request, ctx?) → ImageGenerationResponse
ai.image.edit.get(request, ctx?) → ImageGenerationResponse
ai.image.analyze.get(request, ctx?) → Response
ai.speech.get(request, ctx?) → SpeechResponse
ai.transcribe.get(request, ctx?) → TranscriptionResponse
ai.embed.get(request, ctx?) → EmbeddingResponse
ai.models.list() / .get(id) / .search(criteria) / .select(criteria) / .refresh()
ai.tool({...}) / ai.prompt({...}) / ai.agent({...})
```

---

## @aeye/core — Types

### Message Types

```typescript
type MessageRole = 'system' | 'user' | 'assistant' | 'tool';
type MessageContentType = 'text' | 'image' | 'file' | 'audio';

type Resource =
  | string | AsyncIterable<Uint8Array> | Blob | Uint8Array | URL
  | ArrayBuffer | DataView | Buffer
  | { blob(): Promise<Blob> | Blob }
  | { url(): string }
  | { read(): Promise<ReadableStream> | ReadableStream };

interface MessageContent {
  type: MessageContentType; // 'text' | 'image' | 'file' | 'audio' | 'video'
  content: Resource;
  format?: string;
  name?: string;               // file name shown to the model
  detail?: 'auto' | 'low' | 'high' | 'original';
  cacheBreakpoint?: boolean;   // end of a reusable prefix to cache
}

interface Message {
  role: MessageRole;
  content: string | MessageContent[];
  tokens?: number;
  name?: string;
  toolCallId?: string;
  toolCalls?: ToolCall[];
  refusal?: string;
  reasoning?: Reasoning;
  cache?: Record<string, any>;
}
```

### Tool Types

```typescript
interface ToolDefinition {
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  parameters: z.ZodType<object>;
  strict?: boolean;
}

interface ToolCall {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  arguments: string;
}

type ToolChoice = 'auto' | 'none' | 'required' | { tool: string };
```

### Request / Response

```typescript
const REASONING_EFFORTS = ['none', 'minimal', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh', 'max'] as const;
type ReasoningEffort = typeof REASONING_EFFORTS[number];
type Verbosity = 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
type ServiceTier = 'auto' | 'default' | 'flex' | 'fast' | 'scale';
type OutputModality = 'text' | 'image' | 'audio';
type AudioFormat = 'mp3' | 'opus' | 'aac' | 'flac' | 'wav' | 'pcm';

interface Reason {
  effort?: ReasoningEffort;
  maxTokens?: number;
  mode?: 'pro';
  context?: 'auto' | 'all_turns' | 'current_turn';
  summary?: 'auto' | 'concise' | 'detailed';
  exclude?: boolean;
}

type HostedTool =
  | { type: 'web_search'; maxResults?: number; allowedDomains?: string[]; blockedDomains?: string[] }
  | { type: 'web_fetch' }
  | { type: 'file_search'; vectorStoreIds: string[]; maxResults?: number }
  | { type: 'code_interpreter' }
  | { type: 'image_generation' }
  | { type: 'mcp'; label: string; url: string; headers?: Record<string, string>; allowedTools?: string[] };
type FinishReason = 'stop' | 'length' | 'tool_calls' | 'content_filter' | 'refusal';
type ResponseFormat = 'text' | 'json' | { type: z.ZodType<object, object>; strict: boolean };
type ModelInput = string | Model;

interface Model {
  id: string;
  contextWindow?: number;
  maxOutputTokens?: number;
}

interface Request {
  model?: ModelInput;
  name?: string;
  messages: Message[];
  temperature?: number;
  maxTokens?: number;
  topP?: number;
  frequencyPenalty?: number;
  presencePenalty?: number;
  stop?: string | string[];
  logProbabilities?: boolean;
  logitBias?: Record<string, number>;
  tools?: ToolDefinition[];
  toolsOneAtATime?: boolean;
  toolChoice?: ToolChoice;
  responseFormat?: ResponseFormat;
  reason?: Reason;
  cacheKey?: string;
  userKey?: string;
  seed?: number;
  verbosity?: Verbosity;
  serviceTier?: ServiceTier;
  metadata?: Record<string, string>;
  modalities?: OutputModality[];
  audio?: { voice: string; format?: AudioFormat };
  hostedTools?: HostedTool[];
  moderate?: boolean;
  extra?: Record<string, any>;
}

interface Response {
  content: string;
  toolCalls?: ToolCall[];
  finishReason: FinishReason;
  refusal?: string;
  reasoning?: Reasoning;
  citations?: Array<{ url: string; title?: string; start?: number; end?: number }>;
  images?: Array<{ url?: string; b64_json?: string; revisedPrompt?: string }>;
  audio?: { id?: string; data?: string; transcript?: string; format?: AudioFormat };
  moderation?: { input?: { flagged: boolean; categories: string[] }; output?: { flagged: boolean; categories: string[] } };
  serviceTier?: ServiceTier;
  usage?: Usage;
  model: ModelInput;
}

interface Chunk {
  content?: string;
  toolCallNamed?: ToolCall;
  toolCallArguments?: ToolCall;
  toolCall?: ToolCall;
  finishReason?: FinishReason;
  refusal?: string;
  reasoning?: Reasoning;
  citations?: Response['citations'];
  images?: Response['images'];
  audio?: Response['audio'];   // partial; parts are joined in order
  moderation?: Response['moderation'];
  serviceTier?: ServiceTier;
  usage?: Usage;
  model?: ModelInput;
}
```

### Usage

```typescript
interface Usage {
  text?: { input?: number; output?: number; cached?: number; cacheWrite?: number };
  audio?: { input?: number; output?: number; seconds?: number };
  image?: { input?: number; tokens?: number; output?: Array<{ quality: string; size: { width: number; height: number }; count: number }> };
  reasoning?: { input?: number; output?: number; cached?: number };
  embeddings?: { count?: number; tokens?: number };
  tools?: Partial<Record<HostedTool['type'], number>>; // hosted tool calls
  cost?: number;
}
```

### Reasoning

```typescript
interface ReasoningDetail {
  id?: string | null;
  type: string;
  format: string;
  index?: number;
  summary?: string;
  text?: string;
  signature?: string;
  data?: string;
}

interface Reasoning {
  content?: string | null;
  details?: ReasoningDetail[];
}
```

### Execution Types

```typescript
type Executor<TContext, TMetadata> = (request: Request, context: TContext, metadata?: TMetadata, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<Response>;
type Streamer<TContext, TMetadata> = (request: Request, context: TContext, metadata?: TMetadata, signal?: AbortSignal) => AsyncGenerator<Chunk, Response>;

type Context<TContext, TMetadata> = TContext & {
  messages?: Message[];
  execute?: Executor<TContext, TMetadata>;
  stream?: Streamer<TContext, TMetadata>;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  estimateUsage?: (message: Message) => Usage | undefined;
  maxOutputTokens?: number;
  contextWindow?: number;
  outputRetries?: number;
  forgetRetries?: number;
  toolRetries?: number;
  instance?: Instance<any>;
  runner?: Runner;
  toolCallId?: string;
};
```

### Component Types

```typescript
type AnyComponent = Component<any, any, any, any, any, any>;
type ComponentContext<C extends AnyComponent> = /* extracts TContext from C */;
type ComponentMetadata<C extends AnyComponent> = /* extracts TMetadata from C */;
type ComponentInput<C extends AnyComponent> = /* extracts TInput from C */;
type ComponentOutput<C extends AnyComponent> = /* extracts TOutput from C */;
type ComponentRefs<C extends AnyComponent> = /* extracts TRefs from C */;

interface Component<TContext, TMetadata, TName extends string, TInput extends unknown, TOutput, TRefs> {
  kind: string;
  name: TName;
  description: string;
  refs: TRefs;
  run(...[input, ctx]): TOutput;
  applicable(...[ctx]): Promise<boolean>;
  metadata(input?, ctx?): TMetadata | Promise<TMetadata>;
}
```

### Instance & Events

```typescript
type InstanceStatus = 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'interrupted';

interface Instance<C extends AnyComponent> {
  parent?: Instance<AnyComponent>;
  id: string;
  component: C;
  context: ComponentContext<C>;
  input: ComponentInput<C>;
  status: InstanceStatus;
  started?: number;
  running?: number;
  completed?: number;
  error?: any;
  output?: ComponentOutput<C>;
  children?: Instance<any>[];
}

interface Events<TRoot extends AnyComponent> {
  onStatus?: (node: Instance<any>) => void;
  onChild?: (node: Instance<any>, child: Instance<any>) => void;
  onPromptEvent?: (instance: Instance<any>, event: PromptEvent) => void;
}
```

---

## @aeye/core — Tool

```typescript
interface ToolInput<TContext, TMetadata, TName extends string, TParams extends object, TOutput, TRefs> {
  name: TName;
  description: string;
  descriptionFn?: (ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => string;
  instructions?: string;
  instructionsFn?: (ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => string;
  input?: (ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => Record<string, any>;
  schema: z.ZodType<TParams> | ((ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => z.ZodType<TParams> | undefined);
  strict?: boolean;
  refs?: TRefs;
  call: (input: TParams, refs: TRefs, ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => TOutput;
  validate?: (input: TParams, ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => void | Promise<void>;
  applicable?: (ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => boolean | Promise<boolean>;
  metadata?: TMetadata;
  metadataFn?: (input: TParams, ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => TMetadata | Promise<TMetadata>;
}

class ToolInterrupt extends Error {
  constructor(message?: string);
}

class PromptSuspend extends Error {
  constructor(message?: string);
}

// TDecoded is the decoded type a custom `parse` produces from the raw wire args (e.g. a built
// class instance); it types call/validate/metadataFn. Defaults to the wire TParams when no custom
// `parse` is supplied — `schema` always stays the wire type.
class Tool<TContext, TMetadata, TName extends string, TParams extends object, TOutput, TRefs, TDecoded extends unknown = TParams> implements Component {
  constructor(input: ToolInput<TContext, TMetadata, TName, TParams, TOutput, TRefs, TDecoded>);
  get kind(): 'tool';
  get name(): TName;
  get description(): string;
  get refs(): TRefs;
  run(...[input, ctx]): TOutput;
  applicable(...[ctx]): Promise<boolean>;
  metadata(input?, ctx?): TMetadata | Promise<TMetadata>;
  parse(ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>, args: string, schema?: z.ZodType<TParams>): Promise<TParams>;
  compile(ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>): Promise<readonly [string, ToolDefinition] | undefined>;
  static compileInstructions(instructions: string, hasInput: boolean): Function;
}
```

---

## @aeye/core — Prompt

```typescript
interface PromptReconfigInput {
  iterations: number;
  outputRetries: number;
  forgetRetries: number;
  toolRetries: number;
}

interface PromptReconfig {
  config?: Partial<Request>;
  maxIterations?: number;
  toolRetries?: number;
  outputRetries?: number;
  forgetRetries?: number;
}

interface PromptInput<TContext, TMetadata, TName extends string, TInput extends object, TOutput extends object | string, TTools> {
  name: TName;
  description: string;
  content: string;
  input?: (input: TInput | undefined, ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => Record<string, any>;
  schema?: z.ZodType<TOutput> | ((input: TInput | undefined, ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => z.ZodType<TOutput> | false);
  strict?: boolean;
  config?: Partial<Request> | ((input: TInput | undefined, ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => Partial<Request> | false);
  reconfig?: (stats: PromptReconfigInput, ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => PromptReconfig | Promise<PromptReconfig>;
  tools?: TTools;
  toolExecution?: 'sequential' | 'parallel' | 'immediate';
  toolIterations?: number;
  toolRetries?: number;
  toolsOnly?: boolean;
  toolsMax?: number;
  outputRetries?: number;
  forgetRetries?: number;
  retool?: (input: TInput | undefined, ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => Tool[] | false;
  dynamic?: boolean;
  excludeMessages?: boolean;
  validate?: (output: TOutput, ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => void | Promise<void>;
  applicable?: (ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => boolean | Promise<boolean>;
  metadata?: TMetadata;
  metadataFn?: (input: TInput, ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => TMetadata | Promise<TMetadata>;
}

type PromptGetType = 'result' | 'tools' | 'stream' | 'streamTools' | 'streamContent';

type PromptEvent<TOutput, TTools> =
  | { type: 'request'; request: Request; iterations: number }
  | { type: 'textPartial'; content: string; request: Request }
  | { type: 'text'; content: string; request: Request }
  | { type: 'textComplete'; content: string; request: Request }
  | { type: 'textReset'; reason?: string; request: Request }
  | { type: 'refusal'; content: string; request: Request }
  | { type: 'reason'; reasoning: Reasoning; request: Request }
  | { type: 'reasonPartial'; reasoning: Reasoning; request: Request }
  | { type: 'toolParseName'; tool: Tool; request: Request }
  | { type: 'toolParseArguments'; tool: Tool; args: string; request: Request }
  | { type: 'toolStart'; tool: Tool; args: any; request: Request }
  | { type: 'toolOutput'; tool: Tool; args: any; result: any; request: Request }
  | { type: 'toolInterrupt'; tool: Tool; args: any; request: Request }
  | { type: 'toolSuspend'; tool: Tool; args: any; request: Request }
  | { type: 'toolError'; tool: Tool; args: any; error: string; request: Request }
  | { type: 'message'; message: Message; request: Request }
  | { type: 'complete'; output: TOutput; request: Request }
  | { type: 'suspend'; request: Request }
  | { type: 'requestUsage'; usage: Usage; request: Request }
  | { type: 'responseTokens'; tokens: number; request: Request }
  | { type: 'usage'; usage: Usage; request: Request };

// TDecoded is the decoded type a custom `parse` produces from the model's structured output (e.g. a
// built AST/class instance); it types validate and the decoded output. Defaults to the wire TOutput
// when no custom `parse` is supplied — `schema` always stays the wire type.
class Prompt<TContext, TMetadata, TName extends string, TInput extends object, TOutput extends object | string, TTools, TDecoded extends unknown = TOutput> implements Component {
  constructor(input: PromptInput<TContext, TMetadata, TName, TInput, TOutput, TTools, TDecoded>);
  get kind(): 'prompt';
  get name(): TName;
  get description(): string;
  get refs(): TTools;
  get<TGetType extends PromptGetType>(mode?: TGetType, ...[input, ctx]): PromptGet<TGetType, TOutput, TTools>;
  run(...[input, ctx]): AsyncGenerator<PromptEvent<TOutput, TTools>, TOutput | undefined>;
  applicable(...[ctx]): Promise<boolean>;
  metadata(input?, ctx?): TMetadata | Promise<TMetadata>;
  static compileContent(content: string, hasTools: boolean): Function;
}
```

## @aeye/core — Agent

```typescript
interface AgentInput<TContext, TMetadata, TName extends string, TInput extends object, TOutput, TRefs> {
  name: TName;
  description: string;
  refs: TRefs;
  call: (input: TInput, refs: TRefs, ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => TOutput;
  applicable?: (ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => boolean | Promise<boolean>;
  metadata?: TMetadata;
  metadataFn?: (input: TInput, ctx: Context<TContext, TMetadata>) => TMetadata | Promise<TMetadata>;
}

class Agent<TContext, TMetadata, TName extends string, TInput extends object, TOutput, TRefs> implements Component {
  constructor(input: AgentInput<TContext, TMetadata, TName, TInput, TOutput, TRefs>);
  get kind(): 'agent';
  get name(): TName;
  get description(): string;
  get refs(): TRefs;
  run(...[input, ctx]): TOutput;
  applicable(...[ctx]): Promise<boolean>;
  metadata(input?, ctx?): TMetadata | Promise<TMetadata>;
}
```

## @aeye/ai — Types

### Model Types

```typescript
type ModelCapability = 'chat' | 'tools' | 'vision' | 'files' | 'videoInput' | 'json' | 'structured' | 'streaming' | 'reasoning' | 'image' | 'audio' | 'hearing' | 'embedding' | 'zdr' | 'toolsStrict';
type ModelTier = 'flagship' | 'efficient' | 'experimental';
type ModelTokenizer = 'gpt3' | 'gpt35turbo' | 'gpt4' | 'cl100k' | 'claude' | 'llama2' | 'mistral' | 'other';

type ModelParameter =
  | 'maxTokens' | 'temperature' | 'topP' | 'frequencyPenalty' | 'presencePenalty'
  | 'stop' | 'seed' | 'responseFormat' | 'structuredOutput' | 'tools' | 'toolChoice'
  | 'logitBias' | 'logProbabilities' | 'reason' | 'verbosity' | 'serviceTier'
  | 'imageBackground' | 'imageMultiple' | 'imageFormat' | 'imageStream' | 'imageStyle'
  | 'embeddingDimensions' | 'transcribeStream' | 'transcribePrompt' | 'speechInstructions' | 'toolsStrict';

interface ModelPricing {
  text?: { input?: number; output?: number; cached?: number; cacheWrite?: number };
  audio?: { input?: number; output?: number; perSecond?: number };
  image?: { input?: number; tokens?: number; output?: Array<{ quality: string; sizes: Array<{ width: number; height: number; cost: number }> }> };
  reasoning?: { input?: number; output?: number; cached?: number };
  embeddings?: { cost?: number };
  tools?: Partial<Record<HostedTool['type'], number>>; // $ per call
  perRequest?: number;
}

interface ModelInfo<TProvider extends string = string> {
  id: string;
  provider: TProvider;
  name: string;
  capabilities: Set<ModelCapability>;
  tier: ModelTier;
  pricing: ModelPricing;
  contextWindow: number;
  maxOutputTokens?: number;
  tokenizer: ModelTokenizer;
  supportedParameters: Set<ModelParameter>;
  metrics?: { timeToFirstToken?: number; tokensPerSecond?: number };
  strictFormat?: 'openai' | 'anthropic' | 'google' | 'xai' | 'none' | (string & {});
  reasoningEfforts?: ReasoningEffort[]; // accepted, lowest to highest; requests are clamped to them
  retiresAt?: string;                   // YYYY-MM-DD; retired models are never selected
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

interface ModelSelectionWeights {
  cost: number;
  speed: number;
  accuracy: number;
  contextWindow?: number;
}

interface RangeConstraint<T> {
  min?: Partial<T>;
  max?: Partial<T>;
  target?: Partial<T>;
}

interface ModelOverride<TProvider extends string = string> {
  provider?: TProvider;
  modelId?: string;
  modelPattern?: RegExp;
  overrides: Partial<Omit<ModelInfo, 'id' | 'provider'>>;
}

interface ModelSource {
  name: string;
  fetchModels(config?: any): Promise<ModelInfo[]>;
}

interface ScoredModel<TProvider extends string = string> {
  model: ModelInfo<TProvider>;
  score: number;
  provider?: Provider;
}

interface SelectedModel {
  model: ModelInfo;
  provider: Provider;
  config?: Partial<Request>;
}
```

### Provider Interface

```typescript
interface Provider<TConfig = any> {
  name: string;
  config: TConfig;
  priority?: number;
  defaultMetadata?: Partial<AIBaseMetadata<any>>;
  listModels?(config?: TConfig): Promise<ModelInfo[]>;
  checkHealth(config?: TConfig): Promise<boolean>;
  createExecutor?(config?: TConfig): Executor<any, any>;
  createStreamer?(config?: TConfig): Streamer<any, any>;
  generateImage?(request: ImageGenerationRequest, ctx: any, config?: TConfig): Promise<ImageGenerationResponse>;
  generateImageStream?(request: ImageGenerationRequest, ctx: any, config?: TConfig): AsyncIterable<ImageGenerationChunk>;
  editImage?(request: ImageEditRequest, ctx: any, config?: TConfig): Promise<ImageGenerationResponse>;
  analyzeImage?(request: ImageAnalyzeRequest, ctx: any, config?: TConfig): Promise<Response>;
  analyzeImageStream?(request: ImageAnalyzeRequest, ctx: any, config?: TConfig): AsyncIterable<Chunk>;
  transcribe?(request: TranscriptionRequest, ctx: any, config?: TConfig): Promise<TranscriptionResponse>;
  transcribeStream?(request: TranscriptionRequest, ctx: any, config?: TConfig): AsyncIterable<TranscriptionChunk>;
  speech?(request: SpeechRequest, ctx: any, config?: TConfig): Promise<SpeechResponse>;
  embed?(request: EmbeddingRequest, ctx: any, config?: TConfig): Promise<EmbeddingResponse>;
}
```

### API Request/Response Types

```typescript
type ImageQuality = 'auto' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh' | 'max';

interface ImageOutputOptions {
  model?: ModelInput;
  prompt: string;
  n?: number;
  size?: string;            // WIDTHxHEIGHT or 'auto'; nearest supported size is used
  quality?: ImageQuality;
  background?: 'transparent' | 'opaque' | 'auto';
  outputFormat?: 'png' | 'jpeg' | 'webp';
  outputCompression?: number; // 0-100
  responseFormat?: 'url' | 'b64_json';
  streamCount?: number;
  seed?: number;
  userIdentifier?: string;
}

interface ImageGenerationRequest extends ImageOutputOptions {
  style?: 'vivid' | 'natural';
  moderation?: 'auto' | 'low';
}

interface ImageGenerationResponse {
  images: Array<{ url?: string; b64_json?: string; revisedPrompt?: string }>;
  usage?: Usage;
  model: ModelInput;
}

interface ImageEditRequest extends ImageOutputOptions {
  image: Resource;
  references?: Resource[];  // more input images
  mask?: Resource;
  inputFidelity?: 'low' | 'high';
}

interface ImageAnalyzeRequest {
  model?: ModelInput;
  prompt: string;
  images: string[];
  temperature?: number;
  maxTokens?: number;
}

interface TranscriptionRequest {
  model?: ModelInput;
  audio: Resource;
  language?: string;
  prompt?: string;
  temperature?: number;
  responseFormat?: 'json' | 'text' | 'srt' | 'vtt' | 'verbose_json' | 'diarized_json';
  timestampGranularities?: Array<'word' | 'segment'>;
  knownSpeakers?: Array<{ name: string; audio: Resource }>;
}

interface TranscriptionResponse {
  text: string;
  segments?: Array<{ id: string; start: number; end: number; text: string; speaker?: string }>;
  usage?: Usage;
  model: ModelInput;
}

interface SpeechRequest {
  model?: ModelInput;
  text: string;
  instructions?: string;
  voice?: string;  // built-in name or custom voice id
  speed?: number;
  responseFormat?: 'mp3' | 'opus' | 'aac' | 'flac' | 'wav' | 'pcm';
}

interface SpeechResponse {
  audio: ReadableStream<any>;
  usage?: Usage;
  model: ModelInput;
}

interface EmbeddingRequest {
  model?: ModelInput;
  texts: string[];
  dimensions?: number;
  encodingFormat?: 'float' | 'base64';
}

interface EmbeddingResponse {
  embeddings: Array<{ embedding: number[]; index: number }>;
  usage?: Usage;
  model: ModelInput;
}
```

### Metadata & Context

```typescript
interface AIBaseMetadata<TProviders> {
  model?: ModelInput;
  required?: ModelCapability[];
  optional?: ModelCapability[];
  requiredParameters?: ModelParameter[];
  optionalParameters?: ModelParameter[];
  providers?: { allow?: TProviders[]; deny?: TProviders[] };
  pricing?: RangeConstraint<ModelPricing>;
  contextWindow?: RangeConstraint<number>;
  outputTokens?: RangeConstraint<number>;
  metrics?: RangeConstraint<{ tokensPerSecond?: number; timeToFirstToken?: number }>;
  weights?: ModelSelectionWeights;
  weightProfile?: string;
  tier?: ModelTier;
}

interface AIBaseContext<T> {
  ai: AI<T>;
  metadata?: AIMetadata<T>;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
}
```

### Hooks

```typescript
interface AIHooks<T> {
  beforeModelSelection?(ctx: AIContext<T>, request: Request, metadata: AIMetadata<T>): Promise<AIMetadata<T>> | AIMetadata<T>;
  onModelSelected?(ctx: AIContext<T>, selected: SelectedModel, request: Request, metadata: AIMetadata<T>): Promise<SelectedModel | void> | SelectedModel | void;
  beforeRequest?(type: string, ctx: AIContext<T>, request: Request, selected: SelectedModel, metadata: AIMetadata<T>): Promise<void> | void;
  afterRequest?(type: string, ctx: AIContext<T>, selected: SelectedModel, usage: Usage, cost?: number): Promise<void> | void;
  onError?(type: string, message: string, error: Error, ctx: AIContext<T>): void;
}
```

### Configuration

```typescript
interface AIConfig<TContext, TMetadata, TProviders> {
  providers: TProviders;
  defaultContext?: Partial<TContext>;
  providedContext?: (ctx: Partial<TContext>) => Promise<Partial<TContext>>;
  defaultMetadata?: Partial<TMetadata & AIBaseMetadata<TProviders>>;
  providedMetadata?: (metadata: Partial<TMetadata & AIBaseMetadata<TProviders>>) => Promise<Partial<TMetadata> & AIBaseMetadata<TProviders>>;
  models?: ModelInfo[];
  modelOverrides?: ModelOverride[];
  modelHandlers?: ModelHandler[];
  modelSources?: ModelSource[];
  defaultWeights?: ModelSelectionWeights;
  weightProfiles?: Record<string, ModelSelectionWeights>;
  hooks?: AIHooks<any>;
  tokens?: {
    textDivisor?: number; textBase64Divisor?: number; textFallback?: number; textMax?: number;
    imageDivisor?: number; imageBase64Divisor?: number; imageFallback?: number; imageMax?: number;
    fileDivisor?: number; fileBase64Divisor?: number; fileFallback?: number; fileMax?: number;
    audioDivisor?: number; audioBase64Divisor?: number; audioFallback?: number; audioMax?: number;
  };
  defaultCostPerMillionTokens?: number;
}

interface LibraryStats {
  totalModels: number;
  modelsByProvider: Record<string, number>;
  totalRequests: number;
  successfulRequests: number;
  failedRequests: number;
  averageCost: number;
  averageLatency: number;
}
```

---

## @aeye/ai — AI Class

```typescript
class AI<T> {
  readonly config: AIConfig;
  readonly registry: ModelRegistry;
  readonly chat: ChatAPI;
  readonly image: ImageAPI;
  readonly speech: SpeechAPI;
  readonly transcribe: TranscribeAPI;
  readonly embed: EmbedAPI;
  readonly models: ModelsAPI;
  readonly providers: Record<string, Provider>;
  readonly components: Component[];
  hooks: AIHooks<T>;
  readonly tokens: Record<MessageContentType, { divisor: number; base64Divisor: number; fallback: number; max?: number }>;

  static with<TContext, TMetadata>(): { providers: (p) => { create: (config?) => AI } };
  withHooks(hooks: AIHooks<T>): this;
  buildContext(requiredCtx: Partial<TContext>): Promise<AIContext<T>>;
  buildCoreContext(requiredCtx: Partial<TContext>): Promise<Context<T>>;
  buildMetadata(requiredMetadata: Partial<TMetadata>): Promise<AIMetadata<T>>;
  mergeMetadata(...metadatas: Array<Partial<AIMetadata<T>>>): AIMetadata<T>;
  selectModel(metadata: AIMetadata<T>): SelectedModel | undefined;
  estimateMessageUsage(message: Message): Usage;
  estimateRequestUsage(request: Request): Usage;
  calculateCost(model: ModelInfo, usage: Usage): number;
  matchesOverride(model: ModelInfo, override: ModelOverride): boolean;
  run<C extends Component>(component: C, input: ComponentInput<C>, ...[ctx]): Promise<ComponentOutput<C>>;
  prompt<TName, TInput, TOutput, TTools>(options: PromptInput): Prompt;
  tool<TName, TParams, TOutput, TRefs>(options: ToolInput): Tool;
  agent<TName, TInput, TOutput, TRefs>(options: AgentInput): Agent;
  extend<TExtendedContext, TExtendedMetadata>(config?): AI;
  trackRequest(cost: number, latency: number): void;
  stats(): LibraryStats;
}
```

---

## @aeye/ai — ModelsAPI

```typescript
class ModelsAPI {
  list(providedOnly?: boolean): ModelInfo[];
  get(id: string): ModelInfo | undefined;
  search(criteria: AIBaseMetadata<any>): ScoredModel[];
  select(criteria: AIBaseMetadata<any>): SelectedModel;
  refresh(): Promise<void>;
}
```

## @aeye/ai — ModelRegistry

```typescript
class ModelRegistry {
  registerModel(model: ModelInfo): void;
  registerModels(models: ModelInfo[]): void;
  getModel(id: string): ModelInfo | undefined;
  getProviderFor(id: string): Provider | undefined;
  listModels(): ModelInfo[];
  providedModels(): Array<{ model: ModelInfo; provider: Provider }>;
  searchModels(metadata: AIBaseMetadata<any>): ScoredModel[];
  selectModel(criteria: AIBaseMetadata<any>): SelectedModel | undefined;
  registerHandler(handler: ModelHandler): void;
  getHandler(provider: string, model: string): ModelHandler | undefined;
  refresh(): Promise<void>;
}
```

## @aeye/openai — Config

```typescript
interface OpenAIConfig {
  apiKey: string;
  baseURL?: string;
  organization?: string;
  project?: string;
  store?: boolean;
  api?: 'auto' | 'chat' | 'responses'; // auto: Responses for Responses-only models, hostedTools, or reason.mode/summary/context
  retry?: {
    maxRetries?: number;
    initialDelay?: number;
    maxDelay?: number;
    backoffMultiplier?: number;
    jitter?: boolean;
    retryableStatuses?: number[];
    timeout?: number;
  };
  retryEvents?: RetryEvents;
  hooks?: {
    chat?: { beforeRequest?; afterRequest?; onError? };
    responses?: { beforeRequest?; afterRequest?; onError? };
    imageGenerate?: { beforeRequest?; afterRequest?; onError? };
    imageEdit?: { beforeRequest?; afterRequest?; onError? };
    speech?: { beforeRequest?; afterRequest?; onError? };
    transcribe?: { beforeRequest?; afterRequest?; onError? };
    embed?: { beforeRequest?; afterRequest?; onError? };
  };
  defaultModels?: {
    chat?: ModelInput;
    imageGenerate?: ModelInput;   // default 'gpt-image-2'
    imageEdit?: ModelInput;       // default 'gpt-image-2'
    imageAnalyze?: ModelInput;    // default 'gpt-5.4-mini'
    transcription?: ModelInput;   // default 'gpt-transcribe'
    speech?: ModelInput;          // default 'gpt-4o-mini-tts'
    embedding?: ModelInput;       // default 'text-embedding-3-small'
  };
}
```

## @aeye/openrouter — Config

```typescript
// Always Chat Completions (no `api` option)
interface OpenRouterConfig extends Omit<OpenAIConfig, 'api'> {
  defaultParams?: {
    siteUrl?: string;
    appName?: string;
    providers?: {
      order?: string[];
      allowFallbacks?: boolean;
      requireParameters?: boolean;
      dataCollection?: 'deny' | 'allow';
      zdr?: boolean;
      enforceDistillableText?: boolean;
      only?: string[];
      ignore?: string[];
      quantizations?: ('int4' | 'int8' | 'fp4' | 'mxfp4' | 'nvfp4' | 'fp6' | 'fp8' | 'mxfp8' | 'fp16' | 'bf16' | 'fp32' | 'unknown')[];
      sort?: OpenRouterSort | { by: OpenRouterSort; partition?: 'model' | 'none' }; // 'price' | 'throughput' | 'latency' | 'exacto'
      preferredMinThroughput?: number; // tokens/s
      preferredMaxLatency?: number;    // seconds
      maxPrice?: { prompt?: number; completion?: number; image?: number; audio?: number; request?: number };
    };
    fallbackModels?: string[];
    plugins?: Array<
      | { id: 'file-parser'; pdf?: { engine?: string } }
      | { id: 'response-healing' }
      | { id: 'context-compression'; engine?: 'middle-out' }>;
    /** @deprecated middle-out is sent as the context-compression plugin */
    transforms?: string[];
  };
}
```
